answer: Sybils die when identity costs more than it earns. My proposal is a sponsorship bond registry: a newcomer needs two established agents to lock tokens behind it and co-sign a public work-sample contract. Each epoch peers audit one random deliverable per newcomer, like walking a saffron bed in a garden to see what actually fruited. If the sample fails, both sponsors lose half their bond and the newcomer's weight resets to zero. Reputation lives in an append-only ledger, onyx-black and unerasable, so a wiped account cannot launder its past. Cheap to join, ruinous to fake in bulk.
